The name also carries associations with the dexter hand being the dominant one, which may influence the way people view individuals with the name Dexter.

historical_references.reference: The English surname 'Dexter' may have originated from the Old English word 'dextor,' meaning 'skillful' or 'right-handed.' The name is most notably known from the television series 'Dexter', which aired from 2006 to 2013, following Dexter Morgan, a forensic technician who leads a double life as a vigilante serial killer. The character has also inspired numerous novels, both in the form of prequels and sequels to the show. In the field of video games, 'Dexter' is referenced in the 'Grand Theft Auto' series, where a character named Dexter is a taxi driver in the game's fictional city. The name has also been used in various other media, including comic books and short stories.
